changeinfo.changes: -Fixed a slow but constant memory leak which would cause a crash after around 3 hours. -Fixed a crash which would occur when restarting a map, if the game was launched while signed out of PSN. -Fixed crash when joining a friends session through your friends list in the dashboard, if that session was created via 'keep searching'. -Some improvements to overall stability. -Fixed Leaderboards failing to show entries, and record them, after playing several levels. -Fixed bug allowing you to select a 'couch multiplayer' saved games when creating or joining a 'player match'. Only 'couch multiplayer' allows saving and loading. -No longer possible to add hotset players in 'player match' games, the square button was still bound although the button was not visible. -Signing out of PSN during gameplay now triggers appropriate messages and ends the game for you, rather than requiring you to manually exit the game. -Fixed issue causing the primary local player to unnecessarily leave/abandon the game when a secondary local player signs out of PSN. -Losing connection to the game session no longer counts as a victory (no trophy awarded) for the player being disconnected.

-Fixed not being able to see beyond the first page in leaderboards. -Fixed issue allowing games with more than two players to sometimes start with the armies/teams out of sync. -Fixed some matches not having turn time limits, if they were created through 'keep searching'.
